what: First live run of MiniMaxH3FrozenVideoCache (frozen_video_cache.py, 0.143.0) on the FlashGen audio-refine arm, diner scene, one seed. Arms: refine = the uncached refine graph (h3_probe_t2v_flashgen_4step_audio_refine); refine_cached_verify = the cached graph with verify on, which also runs each cached step stock and logs the audio velocity's cosine against it; refine_cached = the cached graph as shipped, for wall time. 1344x768, 345 frames.
why: The owner, 2026-09-25: the refine pass is a big cost; port our own cache rather than depend on ComfyUI-H3-AudioRefine. The CPU check (bench/check_frozen_video_cache.py) cannot settle the kitchen backend with a short query, memory on the card, wall time, or what the approximation costs on real audio.
